create.ponder.fan_direction.text_1: Spin an Encased Fan and it pushes a stream of air out of its front
create.ponder.fan_direction.text_2: Reverse the rotation and the fan pulls air in instead; faster rotation makes the stream reach further
create.ponder.fan_processing.text_1: An air stream that flows through lava comes out hot
create.ponder.fan_processing.text_2: Items lying in the hot stream get smelted
create.ponder.fan_processing.text_3: Raw food would simply burn up in there
create.ponder.fan_processing.text_4: Blow the air through fire instead to smoke food
create.ponder.fan_processing.text_5: Air that passes through water forms a washing stream
create.ponder.fan_processing.text_6: Washing opens up a few new kinds of processing
create.ponder.fan_processing.text_7: A faster fan only reaches further: the items are not processed any quicker
create.ponder.fan_processing.text_8: Items resting on Depots or moving along Belts can be processed by the stream as well
create.ponder.millstone.text_1: A Millstone grinds the items put into it
create.ponder.millstone.text_2: Cogwheels next to it can drive it from the side
create.ponder.millstone.text_3: Drop or insert the items in from above
create.ponder.millstone.text_4: Once it has finished, [Right-Click] it to take out the result
create.ponder.millstone.text_5: Funnels and other machines can pull the output out automatically
create.ponder.crushing_wheels.text_1: Two Crushing Wheels side by side make a powerful grinder
create.ponder.crushing_wheels.text_2: Power them so that their facing sides both turn inward, toward each other
create.ponder.crushing_wheels.text_3: Anything dropped or inserted between them from above gets crushed
create.ponder.crushing_wheels.text_4: Machines like Chutes and Depots can feed them and collect the products
create.ponder.mechanical_mixer.header: Processing Items with the Mechanical Mixer
create.ponder.mechanical_mixer.text_1: A Mechanical Mixer above a Basin can automate a number of crafting recipes
create.ponder.mechanical_mixer.text_2: It handles every shapeless crafting recipe, and some extra mixing recipes too
create.ponder.mechanical_mixer.text_3: Certain recipes only work when a Blaze Burner heats the Basin
create.ponder.mechanical_mixer.text_4: If two recipes overlap, set the filter slot to pick the one you want
create.ponder.mechanical_press.header: Processing Items with the Mechanical Press
create.ponder.mechanical_press.text_1: The Mechanical Press works on items placed under it
create.ponder.mechanical_press.text_2: Throw the input onto a Depot under the Press, or put it there by hand
create.ponder.mechanical_press.text_3: Items can also arrive on a Mechanical Belt...
create.ponder.mechanical_press.text_4: ...where the Press stops them, presses them and lets them move on
create.ponder.mechanical_press_compactin: Compacting items with the Mechanical Press
When the Press works on a Basin, it compacts the items inside
This covers every fully filled 2x2 or 3x3 crafting recipe, along with a few special ones
Some of them need a Blaze Burner heating the Basin
When two recipes clash, choose one using the filter slot
create.ponder.basin.text_1: Basins hold items and fluids that machines will process
create.ponder.basin.text_2: Whatever a process produces, the Basin tries to hand down to a block beside and below it
create.ponder.basin.text_3: With a fitting block there, the Basin grows a little output spout on that side
create.ponder.basin.text_4: Chests, Depots, Belts and other inventories all work there
create.ponder.basin.text_5: Products then drop into the inventory underneath
create.ponder.basin.text_6: With no output spout, the Basin keeps whatever it makes
create.ponder.basin.text_7: That is handy when a product is an ingredient for the next step
create.ponder.basin.text_8: The products you want must then be pulled out of the Basin
create.ponder.basin.text_9: Give the extractor a filter so it leaves unprocessed ingredients alone
create.ponder.empty_blaze_burner.text_1: [Right-Click] a Blaze while holding an Empty Blaze Burner to trap it inside
create.ponder.empty_blaze_burner.text_2: A Blaze spawner works too: use the burner on it directly
create.ponder.empty_blaze_burner.text_3: Now you hold a perfect source of heat for many machines
create.ponder.empty_blaze_burner.text_4: As decoration, an Empty Blaze Burner can be set alight with Flint and Steel
create.ponder.empty_blaze_burner.text_5: Use an item touched by souls on it to change the colour of the flame
create.ponder.empty_blaze_burner.text_6: Without a Blaze inside, though, they cannot heat any machine
create.ponder.blaze_burner.text_1: A Blaze Burner heats whatever is being processed in the Basin above it
create.ponder.blaze_burner.text_2: To do so, the Blaze needs to be fed something that burns
create.ponder.blaze_burner.text_3: Feeding it a Blaze Cake makes it burn hotter still
create.ponder.blaze_burner.text_4: Deployers or Mechanical Arms can take care of the feeding for you
create.ponder.depot.text_1: A Depot acts like a single belt segment that does not move
create.ponder.depot.text_2: [Right-Click] it to put an item on or take it back off
create.ponder.depot.text_3: Machines can process what sits on it, just like on a belt
create.ponder.depot.text_4: ...and Mechanical Arms can pick items up from it
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_1: Hold an Ejector, Sneak and [Right-Click] a block to choose where it will throw
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_2: Once placed, it throws things toward the chosen spot
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_3: The target may be higher, lower or further away, as long as it is in range
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_4: It must lie straight ahead of the Ejector, never off to one side
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_5: With no valid target chosen, it simply aims at the block right in front of it
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_6: Rotational force winds it up and readies it to launch
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_7: Putting an item on it sets it off
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_8: If an inventory is the target, it waits until there is room for the item
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_9: The value panel lets you set a required stack size
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_10: From then on, it only fires once the stack it holds reaches that size
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_11: Players and mobs that step onto an Ejector always set it off
create.ponder.weighted_ejector_tunnel.he: Splitting item stacks using Weighted Ejectors
create.ponder.weighted_ejector_tunnel.te: Put a Brass Tunnel and an Ejector together to split exact amounts off a stack
Set the Brass Tunnel to 'Prefer Nearest' first, so its side exit is used first
The stack size configured on the Ejector decides how many items get split off
A stack of exactly that size leaves through the side and is thrown away...
...while the rest carries on along the belt
An Ejector that receives a redstone signal will not fire
An Observer facing the Ejector notices every launch
create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_1: A grid of Mechanical Crafters can craft any crafting recipe automatically
create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_2: [Right-Click] them with a Wrench to change the direction of their paths
create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_3: Every path must end up at one single exit, which may be on any side
create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_4: Finished items are put into the inventory at that exit
create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_5: The crafters need rotational force to run
create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_6: [Right-Click] the front of a crafter to put an item in by hand
create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_7: As soon as each slot along the paths holds an item, crafting begins
create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_8: If a recipe leaves some crafters empty, a redstone pulse forces it to start anyway
create.ponder.mechanical_crafter_connect: Machines can insert items into Crafters on their own
Use a Wrench on the backs of Crafters to merge their inputs together
Now one input point fills every crafter linked to it
A recipe with a gap needs an extra crafter to carry the path across it
A Crafter Slot Cover makes a crafter count as an empty slot in the grid
Inputs joined with a Wrench at the back still connect across covered crafters
create.ponder.deployer.text_1: With rotational force, a Deployer can copy the way a player interacts with the world
create.ponder.deployer.text_2: Its target is always the block two spaces ahead of it
create.ponder.deployer.text_3: A block right in front of it does not get in the way
create.ponder.deployer.text_10: [Right-Click] its front to hand it an item to use
create.ponder.deployer.text_11: Items may also be fed in automatically
create.ponder.deployer.text_12: A Deployer has a filter slot as well
create.ponder.deployer.text_13: With a filter set, it only activates while it holds a matching item
create.ponder.deployer.text_14: Only matching items can be inserted then...
create.ponder.deployer.text_15: ...and only items that do not match are pulled back out
create.ponder.deployer_modes.text_1: Out of the box, a Deployer performs a [Right-Click]
create.ponder.deployer_modes.text_2: A Wrench switches it to performing a [Left-Click] instead
create.ponder.deployer_processing.text_1: Holding the right item, a Deployer can process items placed below it
create.ponder.deployer_processing.text_2: Drop the input onto a Depot under it, or place it there yourself
create.ponder.deployer_processing.text_3: When the items come along a belt...
create.ponder.deployer_processing.text_4: ...the Deployer holds each one in place, works on it, then lets it go
create.ponder.deployer_redstone.text_1: While it receives a redstone signal, a Deployer stays idle
create.ponder.deployer_redstone.text_2: A cycle that has already begun is still finished before it stops
create.ponder.deployer_redstone.text_3: So a short break in the signal triggers exactly one cycle
create.ponder.deployer_contraption.text_: When a Deployer is carried along by a moving contraption...
...it acts at every spot it passes, taking items from any inventory on the contraption
Its filter slot chooses which items it pulls from them
Processing Items on the Mechanical Saw
A Mechanical Saw facing upward can cut all kinds of items
The cut item leaves in the direction opposite to the rotation feeding the saw
Saws fit right into a line of Mechanical Belts
When one input has several possible results, the filter slot picks which one you get
With no filter, the saw takes turns producing each possible result
create.ponder.mechanical_saw_breaker.hea: Cutting Trees with the Mechanical Saw
create.ponder.mechanical_saw_breaker.tex: Powered, a Mechanical Saw fells any tree standing right in front of it
To bring the whole tree down, the saw must cut the bottom log that holds it to the ground
create.ponder.mechanical_saw_contraption: When a Saw is carried along by a moving contraption...
...it fells every tree the contraption pushes it into
create.ponder.mechanical_drill.header: Breaking Blocks with the Mechanical Drill
create.ponder.mechanical_drill.text_1: Powered, a Mechanical Drill breaks the block straight in front of it
create.ponder.mechanical_drill.text_2: The faster it spins, the faster it mines
create.ponder.mechanical_drill_contrapti: When a Drill is carried along by a moving contraption...
...it breaks every block the contraption drives it into
